name: Dyoplosaurus
sum: Dyoplosaurus is an ankylosaurid from the Dinosaur Park Formation of Alberta, known from a skeleton with a tail club and skin impressions.
holotype: ROM 784, with a partial skull roof, mandible fragments, osteoderms, skin impressions, vertebrae, ribs, pelvis, tail club and limb bones, obtained in 1919 by Levi Sternberg — Dinosaur Park Formation, Alberta.
exceptional: Skin impressions preserved with the osteoderms.
biology: Armoured herbivore with a tail club.
author: Parks 1924

images.artist: Victoria M. Arbour, Philip J. Currie
images.caption: Holotype of Dyoplosaurus acutosquameus.
